messages.author: 8d4d06c10c4d67c9
messages.subject: Sampling from a half normal
parts:
Hi,

Is it possible to sample from a half normal distribution in stan?

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Sampling from a half normal
parts: On Wednesday, March 6, 2013 10:23:02 AM UTC-5, rubi wrote:

> Hi,
>
>
> Is it possible to sample from a half normal distribution in stan?

Yes. Just constrain the parameter to be positive and use a normal prior. In principle, you should use a truncated normal prior, but in this common case the amount of truncated mass is a constant so explicitly doing the truncation would merely add a constant to the log posterior. There is a post on the FAQ thread about this.

Ben
